label: Sales
description: Each sale completed in Square becomes a paid order in Swell, with the lines, taxes, discounts and total of the receipt, on the customer's account when Swell knows the customer's e-mail address. The orders take no stock (the stock sync does that) and send no customer e-mails. Sales are imported from the moment this is switched on; for earlier ones choose Import past sales in the Actions menu. Leave the locations empty to import the sales of every location.

fields.label: Import completed Square sales as orders
Let other apps and webhooks react to imported orders

actions.label: Import past sales
actions.hint: Imports the Square sales completed since a date

modal.title: Import past sales
modal.description: Imports the sales completed in Square since the date you choose, at the locations set under Sales. A sale that was imported before is not imported twice. The orders appear under Orders → Square sales.

actions.label: Retry failed sales
actions.hint: Tries again to import every sale listed under Needs attention
